ios.desc:
ARDOR is a personalized training platform for functional fitness. Every workout is designed by a coach and adapted to you: your equipment, your schedule, your ability, and how you're recovering.

One workout. Built around you.

THE VELLNER PROGRAM
Hybrid strength and conditioning designed with 5x CrossFit Games medalist Pat Vellner. Six days a week, one theme per day: Olympic lifting, sprint conditioning, bodybuilding, engine work, gymnastics, and a weekly grind. Pick your duration — 30 minutes, an hour, or a full session — and ARDOR fits the day to it.

ADAPTS TO YOU
- Your gym: swap movements for the equipment you actually have
- Your time: the same session, sized to the window you've got
- Your level: same stimulus for a beginner and a Games athlete, different loads
- Your day: readiness and recovery shape what you're asked to do

PREDICTS, THEN LEARNS
Enter one number — a time, a weight — and ARDOR predicts the rest. Every result you log sharpens the next workout. The program gets more yours every week.

TRAIN TOGETHER
Relative leaderboards that measure effort, not just output. Share any workout with a friend and ARDOR adapts it to them automatically. Community chat and kudos from people who understand what you just did.

MONTHLY ATHLETE CHALLENGES
Each month a partner athlete publishes an open workout to the whole community. Open it and it's already scaled to you. Post your result, climb the board, and enter the monthly draw. Entries are always free — no purchase necessary. Availability varies by region; see ardor.fitness/draw-rules.

FOR CROSSFIT, HYROX, AND HYBRID ATHLETES
Built for people who train hard and want programming that keeps up.

FREE TO START
Seven days of full access, then $19.99/month or $119.99/year. Cancel anytime through the App Store

Consult a healthcare professional before starting any exercise program.

quotes.text:
Hi all, we've spent the last 2 years building Ardor.

Ardor designs personal fitness routines built around individuals. Factors equipment, schedule, energy level on a given day, and mix of interests/goals.

What makes Ardor special is how it not only predicts what weight and reps you are capable of doing for every exercise, it also makes some wild predictions about your overall fitness. How fast you are? What's your endurance like? It can build workout challenges in the form of a circuit/HIIT and can say things like "based on how you did in your last workout, I think you can do 4 rounds of the following before the timer runs out".

Think FitBod/calibre/fitnessAI if you have heard of any of those, but not just for strength/weightlifting progression. Speed and Endurance auto progression too. And we believe this to be a first.

Takes a crazy amount of calculations to be able to take 500+ exercises, combine them in millions of different ways, and make a prediction about what you are personally capable of. Uses some ML to predict and design evolving routines. Ardor updates what it thinks about you after each workout.

Our goal was to be able to create a way where you could compete against yourself and actually feel progression over time because you got workout goals that pushed you but stayed within your limit/ability.
